metadata.title: VPNRadarLab top-100 VPN ranking
metadata.update_frequency: one-time snapshot (2026-10); current data is on the site

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Place in the VPNRadarLab main ranking (the ranking on https://vpnradarlab.com/) on the export date.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Service name as shown on the site.

fields.name: vpnradarlab_url
fields.description: The service page on vpnradarlab.com with all published data and the score breakdown.

fields.name: overall_score
fields.description: Overall score: weighted sum of the six sub-scores, rounded to 2 decimals as on the site. A red flag caps it at 6.0.

fields.name: score_privacy_jurisdiction
fields.description: Sub-score “Privacy and jurisdiction” (weight 30% of the overall score), rounded to 1 decimal as on the site.

fields.name: score_security_protocols
fields.description: Sub-score “Security and protocols” (weight 20% of the overall score), rounded to 1 decimal as on the site.

fields.name: score_price_fair_terms
fields.description: Sub-score “Price and fair terms” (weight 15% of the overall score), rounded to 1 decimal as on the site.

fields.name: score_censorship_bypass
fields.description: Sub-score “Censorship bypass” (weight 15% of the overall score), rounded to 1 decimal as on the site.

fields.name: score_network_streaming
fields.description: Sub-score “Network and streaming” (weight 10% of the overall score), rounded to 1 decimal as on the site.

fields.name: score_platforms_support
fields.description: Sub-score “Platforms and support” (weight 10% of the overall score), rounded to 1 decimal as on the site.

fields.name: segment
fields.values: Consumer VPN; Free / mobile app; VPN in a security suite; Gaming VPN; Decentralised (dVPN); Smart DNS
fields.description: Segment (category) of the service, as on the site.

fields.name: jurisdiction_country
fields.description: Country whose law the provider operates under, as on the site.

fields.name: eyes_alliance
fields.description: Membership of the jurisdiction in the 5 / 9 / 14 Eyes surveillance alliances: 5 = Five Eyes, 9 = Nine Eyes, 14 = Fourteen Eyes, none = outside all three, not_stated = not determined.

fields.name: red_flag
fields.description: Red flag that caps the overall score at 6.0 (see the methodology).

fields.name: no_logs_policy
fields.description: “No-logs policy” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: independent_no_logs_audit
fields.description: “Independent no-logs audit” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: ram_only_servers
fields.description: “RAM-only servers” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: kill_switch
fields.description: “Kill switch” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: dns_leak_protection
fields.description: “DNS leak protection” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: split_tunnelling
fields.description: “Split tunnelling” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: wireguard
fields.description: “WireGuard” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: openvpn
fields.description: “OpenVPN” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: obfuscation_stealth_mode
fields.description: “Obfuscation (stealth mode)” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: multi_hop
fields.description: “Double VPN / multi-hop” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: open_source_apps
fields.description: “Open-source apps” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: anonymous_signup
fields.description: “Anonymous sign-up” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: free_plan
fields.description: “Free plan” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: crypto_payments
fields.description: “Cryptocurrency” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: torrenting_allowed
fields.description: “Torrenting” as shown on the service page.

fields.name: cheapest_price_eur_month
fields.description: Cheapest published price per month in EUR (longest prepaid term, converted at the snapshot exchange rate), as in the “From” column on the site. Empty: no paid price published.

fields.name: renewal_ratio
fields.description: Renewal price per month divided by the first-term price per month (1.0 = same price at renewal). Empty: renewal price not published.

fields.name: refund_days
fields.description: Money-back guarantee in days; 0 = no money-back guarantee; empty = not stated.

fields.name: max_devices
fields.description: Simultaneous devices per subscription. Empty: unlimited (see unlimited_devices) or not stated.

fields.name: unlimited_devices
fields.description: yes = unlimited simultaneous devices; no = a limit is stated in max_devices.

fields.name: server_countries
fields.description: Number of countries with servers as published by the provider (“50+” is given as 50). Empty: not stated.
